details.summary: Mainline IPv6 link-local networking works on the Touch 10 Ethernet interface; BusyBox obtained the PC's fixed DHCP lease in RAM while the known SSH address stayed intact.
hardware_checks: eth0 MAC 24:16:9d:b6:77:bb matched stock and the host reservation
IPv6 fe80::2616:9dff:feb6:77bb matched the stock address
IPv6 loopback and two host link-local ping replies passed
udhcpc selected 10.77.10.10/24 from 10.77.10.1 and exited zero
Qt PID stayed unchanged, the nowayout watchdog fed, and eMMC remained read-only and unmounted
Host time was set in the volatile system clock; the unconfigured TWL RTC was not written
details.display_test: No display blank/unblank cycles or Qt restarts were performed; the display DTB and Qt binary were inherited from ram104.
details.recovery: One-shot U-Boot restored the factory environment before kernel handoff. Requested recovery returned to healthy stock, and the authorized ADC postflight restored three sensing controls.
limitations: DHCP was observed but did not replace the static rescue address or apply routes and DNS; ram104 remains the default until normal lease management is qualified.
CPU1/SMP, rail policy, suspend, remote cores and SGX remain unqualified; SGX work is parked.
